pro_file.caption: Ours against the pro's Becker, both read as stitch records by one rule: needle-down passes between lifts (a jump, trim or colour change ends a pass); satin crosses by tools/satin_columns, the scale-free detector (three consecutive penetrations whose middle one sits off the chord by at least 0.1 mm, in a run of sign-alternating offsets); column width is that offset; column legs join two crossing penetrations; jitter is the share of consecutive column legs differing by more than 0.15 mm; turn the 90th percentile of the angle change between consecutive column legs. Our fixture is 100 mm wide, the pro's hat file 101.9; the pro's thread colours are its own (grey and black, five blocks).
rows: satin column width p10 / p50 / p90 mm
